name: @claxedo/workspace-relay
description: Relay/tunnel that routes authenticated traffic to workspace runtimes on Cloudflare: JWT workspace tokens and a header-stripping trust boundary

scripts.test: mkdir -p .artifacts/unit && node ../../script/test-deadline.mjs bun test src bench scripts --path-ignore-patterns='**/relay-workerd-*' --path-ignore-patterns='**/bun.test.ts' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.artifacts/unit/junit.xml && node ../../script/test-deadline.mjs bun test src/bun.test.ts --timeout 120000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.artifacts/unit/junit-bun-adapter.xml && node ../../script/test-deadline.mjs bun test src/relay-workerd-backpressure.test.ts src/relay-workerd-binary.test.ts --timeout 240000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.artifacts/unit/junit-workerd.xml
